  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****
  COVID-19 PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING MEETINGS OF
  THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL AND OTHER CITY LEGISLATIVE BODIES

Until further notice, meetings of the Inglewood City Council and other City legislative bodies will be conducted
pursuant to California Government Code section 54953(e), which allows the City to use teleconferencing for
members of the public to access a meeting and to address the legislative body via a call-in option.

CALL-IN OPTION

 1. Members of the public who wish to attend a public meeting and address the City Council or other
  legislative body during a public meeting must use the call-in option noted below:

  l  Members of the public may listen and make oral public comments telephonically by dialing:
  l Dial-in for Closed Session: 1-669-900-6833 Meeting ID: 825 5030 7638 Passcode: 024788
  l Dial-in for Open Session: 1-888-251-2949 or 215-861-0694, using the specific
  access codes detailed below for the respective City Council Dates:

  l October 4, 2022 – Access Code: 5521983# wait 3 seconds and press # again
  l October 11, 2022 – Access Code: 9670024# wait 3 seconds and press # again
  l October 18, 2022 – Access Code: 4345213# wait 3 seconds and press # again
  l October 25, 2022 – Access Code: 1207201# wait 3 seconds and press # again

In the event of a disruption which prevents the City from broadcasting the meeting to the public using the call-in
   l October 11, 2022 – Access Code: 9670024# wait 3 seconds and press # again
  l October 18, 2022 – Access Code: 4345213# wait 3 seconds and press # again
  l October 25, 2022 – Access Code: 1207201# wait 3 seconds and press # again

In the event of a disruption which prevents the City from broadcasting the meeting to the public using the call-in
option, or in the event of a disruption within the City’s control which prevents the public from offering public
comments using the call-in option, the City Council and other legislative body shall take no further action on items
appearing on the meeting agenda until public access to the meeting via the call-in option is restored.

ALTERNATIVE METHODS

The City also provides alternative methods for members of the public to submit comments and/or to observe a
public meeting. The following alternative methods are provided to the public as a matter of convenience only and
the disruption in service to any alternative method does not preclude the City Council or other legislative body from
taking further action on an agenda item. In the event of a disruption to any alternative method below members of
the public should use the call-in option above.

2. Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
electronically for consideration by the City Council or other City Legislative Body by sending them to the City
Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to
8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter.
Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the
close of the public hearings will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City
Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

3. Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:

  l On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable provider for
  details.
  l Live online through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video, at
  https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/

4. Public attendance at Gladys Waddingham Lecture Hall (located adjacent to the Main Library) to view meeting
and make public comments via audio/video.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of
1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any
person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to observe
and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, or service by contacting
the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-412-5280, FAX at 310-412-5533, One Manchester Boulevard,
First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and
aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.

Inglewood, California
  October 4, 2022

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
  October 4, 2022, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  CLOSED SESSION NOT HELD.

  Agenda Item No. CS-1: Not Held

  ******************************************************

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
  hour of 2:01 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman
  Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent: None.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager/Public Works Director
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

180  PROCLAMATION RECOGNIZING OCTOBER AS BREAST CANCER
  AWARENESS MONTH. Mayor Butts read a proclamation recognizing October as
  Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

  MAYOR BUTTS COMMENTS. Mayor Butts read the Rules of Decorum for any
  persons who wished to address the City Council.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agendas, other than the public hearings.

  Marvin McCoy spoke concerning a matter no on the Agenda, and was advised to speak
  towards the end of the meeting to address his concern.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) commented on Agenda Item No. PH-2, and was advised to
  comment during the Public Hearing portion.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Faulk that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  September 29, 2022, in the amount of $3,861,848.50 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  1
   Inglewood, California
  October 4, 2022

301  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – ORDINANCE NO. 23-01 INTRODUCED –
  APPROVING ZONING CODE AMENDMENT 2021-003 (ZCA-2021-003) TO
  AMEND ARTICLES 1, 7, 10, 10.2, 10.3, 10.3.1, 10.4, 10.5, 10.5.1, 10.6, 10.7, 10.8,
  11.1, AND 19 OF CHAPTER 12 (PLANNING AND ZONING) OF THE
  INGLEWOOD MUNICIPAL CODE. The City Clerk announced the next scheduled
  matter was a public hearing to consider an ordinance approving Zoning Code
  Amendment 2021-003 (ZCA-2021-003) to amend Articles 1, 7, 10, 10.2, 10.3, 10.3.1,
  10.4, 10.5, 10.5.1, 10.6, 10.7, 10.8, 11.1, and 19 of Chapter 12 (Planning and Zoning) of
  the Inglewood Municipal Code, to establish regulations for hookah lounges, citywide,
  notice had been given in the time, form, and manner as required by law, an affidavit was
  on file, and no communications were received.

  Artie Fields, City Manager presented the Staff Report dated October 4, 2022.

  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager presented a brief oral report.

  Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address the City
  Council on the Public Hearing.

  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke concerning a matter unrelated to the Public Hearing, and
  was advised to call back towards the end of the meeting.

  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke, opposing the approval of hookah lounges. She stated she
  felt it wasn’t healthy and posed a health risk to citizens.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) asked for clarity of a hookah lounge.

  Mayor Butts closed the public comments at the hour of 2:18 p.m.

  Following discussion, it was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member Padilla that the City Council does hereby Affirm Categorical Exemption
  (EA-CE-2021-053). The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Morales that further
  reading be waived. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, Ordinance No. 23-01 entitled:

  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, TO APPROVE ZONING CODE
  AMENDMENT 2021-003 (ZCA-2021-003) TO AMEND ARTICLES 1, 7, 10,
  10.2, 10.3, 10.3.1, 10.4, 10.5, 10.5.1, 10.6, 10.7, 10.8, 11.1, AND 19 OF CHAPTER 12
  (PLANNING AND ZONING) OF THE INGLEWOOD  MUNICIPAL CODE TO
  ESTABLISH REGULATIONS FOR HOOKAH  LOUNGES

  was introduced by Council Member Morales.

301  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – ORDINANCE NO. 23-02 INTRODUCED –
  APPROVING ZONING CODE AMENDMENT 2022-001 (ZCA-2022-001)
  MODIFICATION TO HEIGHT REGULATIONS IN THE C-2A (AIRPORT
  COMMERICAL) ZONE, CITYWIDE. The City Clerk announced the next scheduled
  matter was a public hearing to consider an ordinance approving Zoning Code
  Amendment 2022-001 (ZCA-2022-001) to modify height regulations in the C-2A
  (Airport Commercial) Zone, citywide, notice had been given in the time, form, and
  manner as required by law, an affidavit was on file, and no communications were
  received.

  Artie Fields, City Manager presented the Staff Report dated October 4, 2022.

  2
   Inglewood, California
  October 4, 2022

  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager presented a brief oral report.

  Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address the City
  Council on the Public Hearing.

  Caller (Name Unknown) thanked Mindy Wilcox for an excellent presentation. He also
  thanked the Council and City Staff for consideration of their application. He stated he
  believed there would be city-wide benefits because of code consistency, accommodations
  for rooftop amenities such as restaurants and lounges, and the ability to work more with
  global hotel brands. Finally, he stated more global hotel franchises were interested in
  working with his company because of the amenities available.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) stated it would be great to the community to know who the
  applicant was who spoke previously. She asked was he associated with The Forum, SoFi,
  Clippers, or another entity.

  Speaker (Name Unknown) commented regarding the locations of the hotel.

  Mayor Butts closed the public comments at the hour of 2:26 p.m.

  Following discussion, it was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member
  Morales that the City Council does hereby Affirm Categorical Exemption (EA-CE-2022-
  064). The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Morales that further
  reading be waived. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, Ordinance No. 23-02 entitled:

  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, TO APPROVE ZONING CODE
  AMENDMENT 2022-001 (ZCA-2022-001) TO MODIFY HEIGHT
  REGULATIONS IN THE C-2A (AIRPORT COMMERCIAL) ZONE
  CITYWIDE

  was introduced by Mayor Butts.
